# Luxe Window Works — Custom Window Treatments

> Custom blinds, shades, shutters, and motorized window treatments across North Idaho, Seattle's Eastside, and the Salt Lake area.

Luxe Window Works is a custom window treatment specialist based in Post Falls, Idaho, serving North Idaho (with in-home consultations, measuring, and installation by Luxe, backed by a lifetime installation guarantee), Seattle's Eastside (Hunter Douglas and Alta Window Fashions by appointment, measured and installed through Hunter Douglas Installation Services), and Utah's Salt Lake area (Hunter Douglas and Alta Window Fashions by appointment, measured and installed through Hunter Douglas Installation Services). Founded by Mark Abplanalp — a 24-year industry veteran — Luxe Window Works specializes in energy-efficient window coverings, motorized smart home integration, and consultative in-home service.

## TWO Products and Outdoor Living

Luxe provides product guidance, custom measurements and professional installation in North Idaho for Highprofile Classic, Highprofile Poly, Colourvue, Weatherwell Elite, Shadesol and Whispertech. Colourvue programs include Essential and Basic; Shadesol programs include Complete and Essential. TWO USA and The Window Outfitters refer to the same manufacturer.

Outdoor shades and aluminum shutters help make covered patios and decks more comfortable and private. Weatherwell Elite offers adjustable louvers and lockable configurations that can add a layer of security at suitable openings, including for seasonal homeowners. Suitability and locking hardware are confirmed during consultation. These shutters are not an insulated room enclosure or a guarantee against forced entry. Whispertech supports compatible shade automation; motors, power and hub requirements are project-specific.

## What We Do

- **Custom Blinds & Shades**: Cellular, roller, solar, roman, and banded shades custom-fitted to any window
- **Plantation Shutters**: Premium shutters for light control and privacy
- **Motorization & Smart Home Integration**: Bond Bridge Pro, motorized shades, smart scene automation
- **Energy Efficiency**: Cellular honeycomb shades reducing energy costs up to 20%, R-values up to 7.86
- **Child Safety**: Cordless and motorized options eliminating cord hazards
- **Free Consultation**: No-pressure in-home consultation and measurement
